offers_products.reason: Online travel platform and app with reviews, hotel meta-search and bookable experiences; digital product is core offering.

offers_services.reason: Marketplace services: booking tours and attractions (Viator), restaurant reservations (TheFork), and advertising to hotels and businesses.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Travelers book experiences (Viator) and use the site; consumers choose and purchase tours and attractions.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hotels, OTAs and restaurants pay for advertising, click-based referrals and subscriptions on the platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from one-off tour bookings and per-click or booking commissions, not subscriptions or contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Travel, tours and hotel advertising are discretionary and drop sharply in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a tour or attraction booking, a hotel click, or a restaurant reservation; small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from the online platform, reviews content and marketplace technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are consumer travelers plus hotels, tour operators and restaurants, many of them small businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light online platform and marketplace; no fleets or properties are needed to grow.

notes: Viator experiences marketplace likely larger than the Tripadvisor-branded segment; the website text does not give the split.
